releases.name: JetBrains 7.2.1-rc.1
releases.body:
### Added

- Added hosted Kilo Cloud sessions to Agent Manager. Cloud workspaces now share the same editor chrome as local and worktree sessions, including session rows, date groups, badges, busy spinners, and refresh from the row menu.
- Cloud discovery now pages through every workspace for a repository, reports the canonical status vocabulary instead of showing healthy workspaces as unknown, and shows the hourly compute price in the workspace header.
- Linked custom router entries to platform benchmarks.
- Indexing now prunes ignored directories and bounds LanceDB index growth.

### Fixed

- Cloud sessions recover their streams after reconnects without leaving tools running or hiding wake progress, and preparation failures are surfaced with sanitized error details.
- Kept hosted stream ownership across restarts and retained transcript subscriptions when the first attachment fails transiently.
- Kept large Cloud repositories from bursting the CLI with concurrent workspace status reads.
- Aligned hosted prompts with the Cloud input contract.
- Established a session's event subscription before startup returns so early updates are not missed.
- Compaction now runs at the configured threshold and stops compaction loops, and chunked compaction gets the normal output budget.
- Scheduled tasks fire once across processes sharing a data directory.
- Kept a reply that another Kilo process is still writing, and preserved the real exit code of a failed background job.
- Restricted browser and MCP OAuth URLs to HTTP(S), and scoped the MCP SSE probe to its own request and redirects.
- Blocked compromised eMudhra certificates.
- Preserved the parent user-agent when loading npm config.

### Changed

- Bundled Kilo CLI pin updated to v7.8.22 (via v7.8.20).
- Updated commonmark to 0.30.1.

releases.body:
### Added

- Added project-scoped agent usage aggregation to the bundled CLI, backed by a pageable agent usage HTTP API.
- Added custom auto routers with client models and local evals.
- Added a session host registry and Kilo Cloud session adapter.
- Agent Manager now fetches the base branch before creating new worktrees.

- Kept the prompt navigator in sync with the hovered stripe and stopped following the prompt after manual scrolling.

  runs the picked model locally. `kilo auto eval <router>` runs the missing

A custom delegator's own `edit` rules, including path-scoped denies such as `edit: { "secrets/**": "deny" }`, now apply only to that agent and no longer constrain the subagents it starts, so use a session-level edit restriction to confine delegated writes. - [#13260](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13260) [`8d5c126`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/8d5c126dc5ed9626fcb861a3a51f3566b73addb6) Thanks [@waewoo](https://github.com/waewoo)! - Allow OpenAI-compatible providers that require string content for tool calls to opt in without changing the default request format.

- [#15124](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15124) [`a85b9a8`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/a85b9a8ba4b16f328ad624f20c7b6f6bb4ff95b8) - Preserve session status timing for accurate overnight activity and blocker reporting.

A custom delegator's own `edit` rules, including path-scoped denies such as `edit: { "secrets/**": "deny" }`, now apply only to that agent and no longer constrain the subagents it starts, so use a session-level edit restriction to confine delegated writes. - [#15131](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15131) [`f9b632f`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f9b632fd6de9b5941603c1cf0adaacf7ad02b1cd) - Refresh an expired MCP OAuth token automatically. Servers that reject an expired access token with `403` (rather than `401`) no longer leave the connection stuck on "authentication required", so a new worktree or project session reconnects without asking you to sign in again.

- [#13260](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13260) [`8d5c126`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/8d5c126dc5ed9626fcb861a3a51f3566b73addb6) Thanks [@waewoo](https://github.com/waewoo)! - Allow OpenAI-compatible providers that require string content for tool calls to opt in without changing the default request format.

- [#15104](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15104) [`0f4936d`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/0f4936df112d1f4b6d1b319c8c9eb2fc55ed957c) - Keep Gemini thought signatures and other OpenRouter reasoning details that arrive late in a response, so later requests in the conversation replay them

- [#14942](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14942) [`b7672ae`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b7672ae502af111048191119d61cea62157291f5) - Show why a provider failed to load — such as rejected credentials or a network error — instead of silently hiding it from the provider list. The CLI, TUI, and VS Code model picker now surface the reason and offer to sign in again when credentials were rejected.

- [#15124](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15124) [`a85b9a8`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/a85b9a8ba4b16f328ad624f20c7b6f6bb4ff95b8) - Preserve session status timing for accurate overnight activity and blocker reporting.

- [#15180](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15180) [`ec376c5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ec376c55b35fd6d8cfb261909c5738c0b9a596e0) - Keep stray console output from dependencies out of the TUI. Warnings written straight to the terminal by libraries running in the session worker — for example the MCP SDK's notice about OAuth tokens saved without an `issuer` — used to land on top of the rendered screen and stay there until a redraw, leaving the splash screen or chat view shredded. Those writes now go to the log file instead.

### 7.8.10

  Automatic OAuth recovery no longer clears stored credentials another session just refreshed, and signing in to a remote MCP server now updates the authentication warning in every open session instead of only the one that started it. The optional MCP stream probe is also restricted to its own endpoint so it cannot rewrite OAuth metadata or token responses.

- [#14857](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14857) [`37f81b1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/37f81b109724e2d3d18b9281d7d575ced361ce29) Thanks [@mardausdennis](https://github.com/mardausdennis)! - Reduce CPU usage while Windows background jobs are running and improve stop handling when a job takes longer to finish.

- [#14757](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14757) [`f01c7dd`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f01c7ddb0ace8a8944a08257ba16138dee4bc737) Thanks [@thomasbrugman](https://github.com/thomasbrugman)! - Avoid enabling thinking automatically for custom providers whose names contain zai or zhipuai.

- [#14651](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14651) [`07848e1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07848e1a2ad60beeb7983cc185fdcae7faf4f7a1) Thanks [@quanzhuo](https://github.com/quanzhuo)! - Report empty summaries and unrecoverable context overflow during compaction instead of silently stopping. - [#14970](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14970) [`296b9de`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/296b9de6e54dacabfb85c128fbc3c51fc342cfd0) - Respect `permission` settings from global and project `kilo.jsonc` in the JetBrains plugin. The clashing command is now skipped and reported as a configuration warning, so the CLI, VS Code, and JetBrains all tell you which command was ignored and why, while the rest keep working. A command list that fails to load also shows a warning in the CLI instead of silently showing no commands.

- Configure transcript display, with a live preview and localized settings.

- Opt in to the Marketplace error handler.

- Let glob search an opt-in allowlist of ignored paths.

### Fixed

- Restore session lists after a CLI reconnect.
- Stop overriding the user permission config.
- Clear MCP sign-in state when the server is removed.
- Make the model reset forget the saved per-mode pick.
- Navigate to transcript parts from the session timeline, and jump to a step when its timeline bar is clicked.
- Auto-expand transcript blocks only while live.
- Recover a missed pending prompt from backend activity.
- Surface unreadable attachments as an inline chat notice.
- Use the primary brand yellow for logos.
- Keep RC builds on the production session database.
- Report why a provider failed to load instead of hiding it.
- Preserve custom agents and edit permissions during delegation.
- Stop automatic MCP OAuth reset and sync auth badges.
- Handle non-UTF-8 ripgrep matches in grep.
- Stop glob and grep include patterns from bypassing `.gitignore`.
- Track Windows background jobs and runner identity natively, and reject stale parent links when stopping them.
- Require explicit user intent before starting Agent Manager sessions or worktrees.
- Expose a reserved command-name clash as `/goal:command`.
- Point cloud sessions at a permitted temp directory.
- Resolve bare model names for task subagents.
- Surface terminal compaction failures.
- Limit Z.ai thinking defaults to built-in providers.
- Avoid false frontmatter errors when saving command files.
- Bound serve shutdown after signals.
- Send tool-result images as user content for Bedrock GPT-6 models.
- Reuse the loaded transcript when pruning large payloads.
- Clean up MCP servers when their startup is interrupted.
- Improve the missing-binary error message for Windows ARM64.
- Retry retryable connection resets through the normal backoff path.
- Start the backend in Windows drive-root workspaces.

releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.9
releases.body:
### Added

- Added a prompt navigator to the chat transcript for jumping between your sent prompts.
- Added MCP OAuth sign-in support, including recovery flows for expired or failed authorizations.
- Combined MCP and skill badges in the chat UI.
- Added a core settings reload action.
- Rendered agent board messages as markdown.

### Fixed

- Fixed hidden session questions not surfacing in the chat UI.
- Made chat dialogs submit with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.
- Fixed spreadsheet date/time handling when reading xlsx and ods files.
- Finalized reasoning output before stream retries to avoid lost context.
- Kept storage usable after an interrupted first access.
- Prevented a rejected attachment from discarding the in-progress prompt.
- Gated prompt cache breakpoints to first-party OpenAI providers.

### Changed

- Renamed JetBrains workflows to commands.
- Split agent guidance documentation into skills.
- Bumped the bundled Kilo CLI pin to v7.8.8 (via v7.8.3 and v7.8.7 intermediate bumps).

### Added

- Rename workflows to commands throughout the JetBrains plugin and improve the related settings presentation.
- Render agent board messages as Markdown.
- Unify goals with scheduling and timing tools so agents can coordinate long-running work more reliably.

### Fixed

- Recover from provider context-limit errors by compacting the conversation automatically.
- Preserve prompt cache breakpoints only for first-party OpenAI providers, avoiding incompatible requests to custom providers.
- Report scheduled sessions with their wake time instead of leaving them in a generic busy state.
- Pass the configured embedding dimension to OpenAI-compatible indexing providers.

### 7.8.0

#### Minor Changes

releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.8
releases.body:
### Added

- Add Checkpoints settings for snapshots and automatic session cleanup, including manual cleanup controls and the latest cleanup result.
- Install companion skills when adding MCP servers from the marketplace.
- Publish CycloneDX software bills of materials alongside JetBrains release artifacts.
- Support MCP servers that use client ID metadata documents for OAuth registration.

### Fixed

- Avoid a crash when reloading or unloading the JetBrains plugin while editor history still references Kilo virtual files.
- Keep model selection isolated to each session, including overlapping agent runs and cleanup.
- Keep sub-agents that belong to an active chat during session cleanup.
- Make background-agent and todo strip headers expand, collapse, and highlight consistently while keeping expanded agent links actionable.
- Show specific revert guidance when snapshots are disabled, a checkpoint is unavailable, or the project is not a Git repository.

### Changed

- Reclaim database space after session cleanup and allow cleanup to be stopped.
- Speed up switching between worktree session editor tabs with long transcripts and reduce unnecessary Agent Manager list repainting.
- Trim single-line transcript labels more consistently with an ellipsis when they overflow.
